title: specialist report
description: Shared shape for the five non-security specialist gates: ux-report.json (ux), db-report.json (database), perf-report.json (performance), data-report.json (data), delivery-report.json (devops). Sole writers: the respective specialist. The server column identifies which file and role a document must match.

role.description: Must match the writer. The validator checks this against the filename.

verdict.description: SKIP is only valid when the activation conditions genuinely did not match, and must carry a reason.

skip_reason.description: Required when verdict is SKIP or NOT APPLICABLE.

evidence.description: The measurement, query plan, observation, or trace that produced this finding.

blocking_findings.description: Finding IDs that must be resolved before merge or deploy.

not_assessed.description: What this specialist could not assess, and why. An honest gap is a finding; a silent gap is a defect.

role_specific.description: Role-specific sections live here. Shapes are declared in each role's definition file. Kept open so a specialist can report rich evidence without a schema churn.
